metric: duplicates + outcome_unknown (+ lost); both upstream modes
honesty: ClawQL arms measured in-process. celld = own substrate (Tier B/C separate). Pi Durable / Golem live arms require DURABILITY_COMPARISON_LIVE_PEERS=1 (local golem server + @earendil-works/pi-durable). Named public peer boards still need maintainer invite before marketing as third-party measured.

arms.honesty: ClawQL file-journal: no write re-send after SIGKILL; resume uses outcome_unknown. Duplicates must be 0 in both upstream modes.
Reference arm: forces write re-send after kill. Idempotent upstream can mask duplicates; non_idempotent multiplies effects. Not ClawQL product behavior.
ProgramCellDO isolate kill is Tier B (`smoke-program-cell-kill.sh`). Fleet peer resume is Tier C (`smoke-program-cell-fleet-kill.sh`). Not inlined into this Node board.
Live @earendil-works/pi-durable: SIGKILL mid-phase, reopen SQLite storage, resume. Idempotent mode uses durable memo; non-idempotent re-applies the write on recovery.
Live local Golem server: WriteAgent fetch mid-flight + `golem agent simulate-crash`. Recovery re-sends outbound HTTP; idempotent upstream masks duplicates.

pi-durable+clawql: ClawQL tool-gate side of the combination (approval consumed → outcome_unknown, never re-send). Peer→MCP live bridge still open; this measures the ClawQL refusal that closes non-idempotent retries.

golem+clawql: ClawQL tool-gate side of the combination (approval consumed → outcome_unknown, never re-send). Peer→MCP live bridge still open; this measures the ClawQL refusal that closes non-idempotent retries.
